page_purpose.description: What this page is for, in one sentence, judged from what you can actually see.

layout.description: The overall arrangement, e.g. 'fixed top bar, left icon rail, centred single-column feed, right sidebar'.

regions.description: The distinct visual regions of the page, in reading order.

name.description: Short name, e.g. 'top navigation', 'post card', 'suggestions sidebar'.

purpose.description: What this region does for the user.

box.description: Approximate position as fractions of the image, 0..1, origin top-left.

repeats.description: True when this region is one instance of a repeated item (a card in a list, a row in a table).

importance.description: How central this region is to the page's purpose. Only 'primary' regions are worth a detailed pass.

notes.description: Anything visibly wrong or missing: blank areas, broken images, unstyled text, overlapping content.
